042        @Override
043        public boolean isHidden() {
044                // Remnants of the LG are integrated into the Diktat military
045                if (Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_achillesWon")) {
046                        return true;
047                }
048                return !market.getFactionId().equals(Factions.DIKTAT);
049        }
050        
051        @Override
052        public boolean isFunctional() {
053                // Remnants of the LG are integrated into the Diktat military
054                if (Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_achillesWon")) {
055                        return false;
056                }
057                return super.isFunctional() && market.getFactionId().equals(Factions.DIKTAT);
058        }
059
060        public void apply() {
061                super.apply(true);
062                
063                int size = market.getSize();
064                
065                demand(Commodities.SUPPLIES, size - 1);
066                demand(Commodities.FUEL, size - 1);
067                demand(Commodities.SHIPS, size - 1);
068                
069                supply(Commodities.CREW, size);
070                
071                demand(Commodities.HAND_WEAPONS, size);
072                supply(Commodities.MARINES, size);
073                        
074                Pair<String, Integer> deficit = getMaxDeficit(Commodities.HAND_WEAPONS);
075                applyDeficitToProduction(1, deficit, Commodities.MARINES);
076                
077                modifyStabilityWithBaseMod();
078                
079                MemoryAPI memory = market.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
080                Misc.setFlagWithReason(memory, MemFlags.MARKET_PATROL, getModId(), true, -1);
081                Misc.setFlagWithReason(memory, MemFlags.MARKET_MILITARY, getModId(), true, -1);
082                
083                if (!isFunctional()) {
084                        supply.clear();
085                        unapply();
086                }
087
088        }
089
090        @Override
091        public void unapply() {
092                super.unapply();
093                
094                MemoryAPI memory = market.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
095                Misc.setFlagWithReason(memory, MemFlags.MARKET_PATROL, getModId(), false, -1);
096                Misc.setFlagWithReason(memory, MemFlags.MARKET_MILITARY, getModId(), false, -1);
097                
098                unmodifyStabilityWithBaseMod();
099        }

143        protected IntervalUtil tracker = new IntervalUtil(Global.getSettings().getFloat("averagePatrolSpawnInterval") * 0.7f,
144                                                                                                          Global.getSettings().getFloat("averagePatrolSpawnInterval") * 1.3f);
145        
146        protected float returningPatrolValue = 0f;

162        @Override
163        public void advance(float amount) {
164                super.advance(amount);
165                
166                if (Global.getSector().getEconomy().isSimMode()) return;
167
168                if (!isFunctional()) return;
169                
170                float days = Global.getSector().getClock().convertToDays(amount);
171                
172                float spawnRate = 1f;
173                float rateMult = market.getStats().getDynamic().getStat(Stats.COMBAT_FLEET_SPAWN_RATE_MULT).getModifiedValue();
174                spawnRate *= rateMult;
175                
176                
177                float extraTime = 0f;
178                if (returningPatrolValue > 0) {
179                        // apply "returned patrols" to spawn rate, at a maximum rate of 1 interval per day
180                        float interval = tracker.getIntervalDuration();
181                        extraTime = interval * days;
182                        returningPatrolValue -= days;
183                        if (returningPatrolValue < 0) returningPatrolValue = 0;
184                }
185                tracker.advance(days * spawnRate + extraTime);
186                
187                //tracker.advance(days * spawnRate * 100f);
188                
189                if (tracker.intervalElapsed()) {
190                        String sid = getRouteSourceId();
191                        
192                        int light = getCount(PatrolType.FAST);
193                        int medium = getCount(PatrolType.COMBAT);
194                        int heavy = getCount(PatrolType.HEAVY);
195
196                        int maxLight = 2;
197                        int maxMedium = 2;
198                        int maxHeavy = 2;
199                        
200                        WeightedRandomPicker<PatrolType> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<PatrolType>();
201                        picker.add(PatrolType.HEAVY, maxHeavy - heavy); 
202                        picker.add(PatrolType.COMBAT, maxMedium - medium); 
203                        picker.add(PatrolType.FAST, maxLight - light); 
204                        
205                        if (picker.isEmpty()) return;
206                        
207                        PatrolType type = picker.pick();
208                        PatrolFleetData custom = new PatrolFleetData(type);
209                        
210                        OptionalFleetData extra = new OptionalFleetData(market);
211                        extra.fleetType = type.getFleetType();
212                        
213                        RouteData route = RouteManager.getInstance().addRoute(sid, market, Misc.genRandomSeed(), extra, this, custom);
214                        float patrolDays = 35f + (float) Math.random() * 10f;
215                        
216                        route.addSegment(new RouteSegment(patrolDays, market.getPrimaryEntity()));
217                }
218        }

227        public int getCount(PatrolType ... types) {
228                int count = 0;
229                for (RouteData data : RouteManager.getInstance().getRoutesForSource(getRouteSourceId())) {
230                        if (data.getCustom() instanceof PatrolFleetData) {
231                                PatrolFleetData custom = (PatrolFleetData) data.getCustom();
232                                for (PatrolType type : types) {
233                                        if (type == custom.type) {
234                                                count++;
235                                                break;
236                                        }
237                                }
238                        }
239                }
240                return count;
241        }
242
243        public int getMaxPatrols(PatrolType type) {
244                if (type == PatrolType.FAST) {
245                        return (int) market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.PATROL_NUM_LIGHT_MOD).computeEffective(0);
246                }
247                if (type == PatrolType.COMBAT) {
248                        return (int) market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.PATROL_NUM_MEDIUM_MOD).computeEffective(0);
249                }
250                if (type == PatrolType.HEAVY) {
251                        return (int) market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.PATROL_NUM_HEAVY_MOD).computeEffective(0);
252                }
253                return 0;
254        }

264        public void reportFleetDespawnedToListener(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, FleetDespawnReason reason, Object param) {
265                if (!isFunctional()) return;
266                
267                if (reason == FleetDespawnReason.REACHED_DESTINATION) {
268                        RouteData route = RouteManager.getInstance().getRoute(getRouteSourceId(), fleet);
269                        if (route.getCustom() instanceof PatrolFleetData) {
270                                PatrolFleetData custom = (PatrolFleetData) route.getCustom();
271                                if (custom.spawnFP > 0) {
272                                        float fraction  = fleet.getFleetPoints() / custom.spawnFP;
273                                        returningPatrolValue += fraction;
274                                }
275                        }
276                }
277        }
278        
279        public CampaignFleetAPI spawnFleet(RouteData route) {
280                
281                PatrolFleetData custom = (PatrolFleetData) route.getCustom();
282                PatrolType type = custom.type;
283                
284                Random random = route.getRandom();
285                
286                float combat = 0f;
287                float tanker = 0f;
288                float freighter = 0f;
289                String fleetType = type.getFleetType();
290                switch (type) {
291                case FAST:
292                        combat = Math.round(3f + (float) random.nextFloat() * 2f) * 5f;
293                        break;
294                case COMBAT:
295                        combat = Math.round(6f + (float) random.nextFloat() * 3f) * 5f;
296                        tanker = Math.round((float) random.nextFloat()) * 5f;
297                        break;
298                case HEAVY:
299                        combat = Math.round(10f + (float) random.nextFloat() * 5f) * 5f;
300                        tanker = Math.round((float) random.nextFloat()) * 10f;
301                        freighter = Math.round((float) random.nextFloat()) * 10f;
302                        break;
303                }
304                
305                FleetParamsV3 params = new FleetParamsV3(
306                                market, 
307                                null, // loc in hyper; don't need if have market
308                                Factions.LIONS_GUARD,
309                                route.getQualityOverride(), // quality override
310                                fleetType,
311                                combat, // combatPts
312                                freighter, // freighterPts 
313                                tanker, // tankerPts
314                                0f, // transportPts
315                                0f, // linerPts
316                                0f, // utilityPts
317                                0f // qualityMod - since the Lion's Guard is in a different-faction market, counter that penalty
318                                );
319                params.timestamp = route.getTimestamp();
320                params.random = random;
321                params.modeOverride = Misc.getShipPickMode(market);
322                params.modeOverride = ShipPickMode.PRIORITY_THEN_ALL;
323                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = FleetFactoryV3.createFleet(params);
324                
325                if (fleet == null || fleet.isEmpty()) return null;
326                
327                fleet.setFaction(market.getFactionId(), true);
328                fleet.setNoFactionInName(true);
329                
330                fleet.addEventListener(this);
331                
332//              PatrolAssignmentAIV2 ai = new PatrolAssignmentAIV2(fleet, custom);
333//              fleet.addScript(ai);
334                
335                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_PATROL_FLEET, true);
336                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.FLEET_IGNORES_OTHER_FLEETS, true, 0.3f);
337
338                if (type == PatrolType.FAST || type == PatrolType.COMBAT) {
339                        fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_CUSTOMS_INSPECTOR, true);
340                }
341                
342                String postId = Ranks.POST_PATROL_COMMANDER;
343                String rankId = Ranks.SPACE_COMMANDER;
344                switch (type) {
345                case FAST:
346                        rankId = Ranks.SPACE_LIEUTENANT;
347                        break;
348                case COMBAT:
349                        rankId = Ranks.SPACE_COMMANDER;
350                        break;
351                case HEAVY:
352                        rankId = Ranks.SPACE_CAPTAIN;
353                        break;
354                }
355                
356                fleet.getCommander().setPostId(postId);
357                fleet.getCommander().setRankId(rankId);
358                
359                for (FleetMemberAPI member : fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
360                        if (member.isCapital()) {
361                                member.setVariant(member.getVariant().clone(), false, false);
362                                
363                                member.getVariant().setSource(VariantSource.REFIT);
364                                member.getVariant().addTag(Tags.TAG_NO_AUTOFIT);
365                                member.getVariant().addTag(Tags.VARIANT_CONSISTENT_WEAPON_DROPS);
366                        }
367                }
368                
369                market.getContainingLocation().addEntity(fleet);
370                fleet.setFacing((float) Math.random() * 360f);
371                // this will get overridden by the patrol assignment AI, depending on route-time elapsed etc
372                fleet.setLocation(market.getPrimaryEntity().getLocation().x, market.getPrimaryEntity().getLocation().y);
373                
374                fleet.addScript(new PatrolAssignmentAIV4(fleet, route));
375                
376                //market.getContainingLocation().addEntity(fleet);
377                //fleet.setLocation(market.getPrimaryEntity().getLocation().x, market.getPrimaryEntity().getLocation().y);
378                
379                if (custom.spawnFP <= 0) {
380                        custom.spawnFP = fleet.getFleetPoints();
381                }
382                
383                return fleet;
384        }
